# AlpacaMap (TravelScout)

> A free, map-based travel planner that collects statements about a city from Wikivoyage, Wikitravel,
> Wikipedia, Reddit and Travel StackExchange and shows where these sources agree or disagree.
> Research prototype; no account, no cookies, no tracking.

## What it does
- "What do sources say about…": one click shows what guides and travellers say about safety, transport, food, money, climate or nightlife in a city.
- Truth lens: coloured dots on the map mark places where sources agree (green) or where opinions split (amber, red).
- Time lens: which places are open, closed or busy at a chosen hour.
- Debates: pairs of statements that may disagree; the traveller judges them.
- Itinerary, routes, budget, packing lists and notes, stored only in the visitor's browser.

## Data and limits
- Ready-made knowledge for London, Paris, Rome, Edinburgh and Zurich; other cities are loaded live.
- Topics, tone and "possible contradiction" labels are assigned automatically and can be wrong.
- Not official travel advice.
